description: Mathematical binding between MT-LAW-A persistence and LAW021 budget constraints, requiring all persistence claims to be finite-budget bounded.

binding_logic.budget_constrained_persistence: MT-LAW-A persistence is not a primitive property but a budget-constrained outcome. Persistence (S_achieved) is only valid while the local admissibility budget B_A (LAW021) is non-zero and covers the maintenance cost P_stab.
binding_logic.resilience_as_headroom: The Cost-to-Destabilize (S_C) is mathematically bounded by the available budget headroom: S_C <= (B_A - Cost_A_maintenance).

formal_mappings.operational_note: A channel cannot resist a perturbation larger than its remaining admissibility budget can damp.
Persistence failure in MT-LAW-A is operationally equivalent to budget saturation in LAW021.

enforcement_rules.description: All TS4 persistence claims MUST report the local budget state B_A and maintenance cost Cost_A.
If B_A < Cost_A, the claim status MUST be downgraded to 'FAILED' or 'TRANSITIONING', regardless of current S_achieved.
